entries.b49b4e644783eb00: Under its corporate philosophy 'Kandō Creation Company', it aims for sustainable growth and higher corporate value through three missions: 'Kandō Sekkyaku', 'Kandō Shōhin' and 'Kandō Uriba'. For the next fiscal year, under the theme 'Challenge & Change', it plans to pursue four priority measures: 'evolution of the Premium Store Group and New Standard Store Group', 'challenges in new store formats', 'strengthening of overseas wholesale' and 'strengthening of the MD and EC divisions'. It also plans to expand its business scope through entry into the manufacturing division via M&A and other means, and by introducing new product categories.

entries.c55f3131675c3888: In the current fiscal year, although inbound sales remained firm, revenue fell 1.9% year on year to ¥51,270 million, due to a slightly weaker trend in domestic demand and a decline in the number of stores. It worked on strengthening character collaboration products, reaching younger customers, and OMO initiatives, with app members approaching 1.4 million.
